draft_en.subject: DIN-rail industrial PoE switches - second source for your line card
draft_en.body:
Hi,

Saga Telecom builds DIN-rail industrial Ethernet switches for distributors who already carry automation and industrial communication brands and want a second source at a lower price point, FCC/ISED.

STI-288DGGPM: DIN-rail industrial L2+ switch, 8 x GE PoE+ (240 W budget) + 2 x SFP (1G/2.5G), -40 to +75 C, dual DC input, ERPS ring, SNMPv3, USD 137 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days), FCC/ISED/RoHS, 3-year warranty. Same family: STI-244DGGPM (4 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, 120 W) at USD 121 and STI-488DGGPM (8 x PoE+ + 4 x SFP, 240 W) at USD 147.

Would a lower-priced DIN-rail PoE switch be worth a test unit as a second source for your panel-builder customers?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
